concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-method-create-node]] - Node.js existing-customer payment-method creation with required customer ID and nonce, default and billing-address behavior, payment-type limits on duplicate rejection, card-verification and Premium Fraud Management Tools guidance, and nonce-versus-raw-card precedence
warnings: Preserve the existing-customer scope and the stated customer-ID plus payment-method-nonce prerequisite; do not turn the linked customer-creation route into evidence about that separate operation.
Keep first-created default behavior distinct from explicitly setting the new method as default with makeDefault.
Preserve that a supplied billing address is ignored for a PayPal account and overrides an address supplied during nonce creation.
Do not generalize duplicate rejection to PayPal, Pay with Venmo, Apple Pay, Google Pay, or ACH payment methods, and do not infer undocumented duplicate-matching rules.

Distinguish default credit-card validation from card verification; retain the account-wide recommendation, the manual verifyCard route, and the device_data recommendation specifically for Premium Fraud Management Tools card-verification attempts.
Preserve the recommendation to pass only a nonce and the documented precedence when raw card fields and nonce attributes are combined.
